title: UAE Emergency News
summary: I built a Telegram channel that delivers breaking war news from 20 sources in Korean every three minutes to help keep colleagues and friends in the UAE safe.
content:
Together with Zeon, I built a Telegram channel that translates local breaking news about the war into Korean and posts it every three minutes, for my colleagues and Korean friends living in Abu Dhabi.

https://t.me/uae_emergency_news

If you have family or friends in the UAE, please share it with them. I sincerely hope everyone stays safe.

It draws on the following 20 sources.

| #  | Source                 | Focus          |
| --- | ------------------ | ----------- |
| 1  | Al Jazeera         | Leading Middle East outlet       |
| 2  | The National       | UAE local      |
| 3  | Gulf News          | UAE local      |
| 4  | Khaleej Times      | UAE local      |
| 5  | Arab News          | Saudi Arabia         |
| 6  | Reuters            | Global         |
| 7  | AP News            | Global         |
| 8  | BBC                | Global         |
| 9  | CNN                | Global         |
| 10 | Al Arabiya         | Arab world         |
| 11 | WAM                | UAE official state news agency |
| 12 | France24           | Global         |
| 13 | Iran International | Monitoring Iran       |
| 14 | Middle East Eye    | Middle East specialist       |
| 15 | Times of Israel    | Israel        |
| 16 | Haaretz            | Israel        |
| 17 | Al-Monitor         | Middle East analysis       |
| 18 | DW                 | Global         |
| 19 | Jerusalem Post     | Israel        |
| 20 | Sky News Arabia    | Arab world         |
